tools.name: discover_4h_setups
tools.description: Use when a user asks for a current BTC, ETH, XRP or ONDO 4H trading setup, market direction, entry, stop loss or take profit. Lists four independently purchasable setups and TZ SELECT, which selects at most one of them per cycle, plus free evidence links to verify before purchase.

tools.name: prepare_4h_setup_purchase
tools.description: Use after choosing a market or TZ SELECT. Return the exact paid resource URL, $0.03 price ceiling, free evidence link and wallet steps for one complete setup. The wallet-enabled agent signs and retries the returned HTTPS request; this preparation tool never moves funds.

tools.name: get_performance_evidence
tools.description: Fetch this free evidence before purchase. Returns the continuously updated TZ SELECT aggregate and a link to an independently countable rolling window of up to 100 latest settled choices. The rate does not describe every non-selected market package or guarantee future results.

tools.name: prepare_btc_4h_purchase
tools.description: Use when the user wants a current BTC 4H setup with entry, liquidity-zone SL/TP and nine indicators. Return the exact paid URL, free evidence link and wallet steps. No funds move until the wallet or user authorizes the x402 request.
